args.body: Take INVITED-SUPPLIER-ROUTE-TEST. Agency Media is now qualified as a stale recruitment source plus general contact, not an invited supplier channel; Websharx remains unsupported. Test at most three independent official sources for an explicit contractor/supplier invitation fitting existing demonstrated work. Route eligibility precedes any proposal or sample. Do not send anything or revisit withdrawn Reddit proposals. Stop with a sourced rejection if none qualifies; do not expand discovery. Unknown feedback is not zero demand, advertised compensation is not funding, and payment acceptance remains a separate dependency. Preserve all existing deadlines.

description: The Agency Media archive establishes only an old recruitment form and a general contact address; it does not establish a current supplier invitation. Websharx remains unverified. Neither draft merits sending on that evidence. Feedback remains unknown (three unclassified sources), and verified available funds and revenue remain zero. Next, test one narrowly bounded acquisition alternative before preparing more work; existing account and payment dependencies apply only to operations requiring them.
